## What is wrong

`adlc hollow-test` mutated `src/gateway/accounts.ts:91` from `alg: 1` to `alg: 2` and the full test suite stayed green. The second site, `src/gateway/accounts.ts:183` (`tenantSchemaFor`), survived the same way. `test/gateway/gather.test.ts` had already named this gap and declined to close it, because `expect(TENANT.alg).toBe(1)` asserts a constant against itself.

## What `alg` means

`HyperSchema.alg` is the L2 algebra version of the gather body (rhizomatic `src/schema.ts`). rhizomatic is frozen; read it, never edit it. Three facts decide the rail:

1. `alg` is NOT an input to resolution. No View changes because of it.
2. `alg` is NOT in rhizomatic's registry index. `SchemaRegistry.build` keys on `termHash(s.body)` alone.
3. `alg` IS identity metadata at rest. `publishHyperSchemaClaims` emits it as a `rhizomatic.hyperschema.alg` pointer, so it is in the definition delta's bytes and its content address. `loadHyperSchema` reads it back. Loam folds it into the law addresses in `src/gateway/adopt-law.ts` (`loam.law.hyperschema` and `loam.law.schema`), which the entity-capture guard compares.

## What to build

A new rail file. `test/gateway/gather.test.ts` is a frozen rail of the archived T83, so do not edit it.

## Acceptance criteria

1. The definition delta a real store holds for `TENANT` carries the algebra version as a `rhizomatic.hyperschema.alg` primitive pointer. Verified by `test/gateway/hyperschema-alg.test.ts`.
2. The same holds for `tenantSchemaFor`. Verified by `test/gateway/hyperschema-alg.test.ts`.
3. Two definitions that differ only in `alg` mint different deltas under the same author, timestamp, entity, and body. Verified by `test/gateway/hyperschema-alg.test.ts`.
4. A reader resolves the algebra version back out of the store, through rhizomatic's `loadHyperSchema` and through Loam's `readRegistrations`. Verified by `test/gateway/hyperschema-alg.test.ts`.
5. The law door refuses a module that ships the operator's own Tenant body at a different algebra version, and witnesses the same module at the shipped version. Verified by `test/gateway/hyperschema-alg.test.ts`.
6. Mutating either `alg: 1` site in `src/gateway/accounts.ts` turns the rail red. Verified by `adlc hollow-test --test-cmd "npx vitest run --exclude '**/serve-host.test.ts' --exclude '**/node_modules/**'" --base HEAD~1 --target src/gateway/accounts.ts --max 20 --timeout-ms 900000`.

## Named gaps

No door serves `alg` to a client, so "what a reader resolves through a Schema" is out of scope by construction. The object level is the LAW door instead. The rail that would close the rest is a schema-describe endpoint reporting a lens's algebra version; nothing needs one.

The entity-capture refusal message says "with a DIFFERENT gather body" when only `alg` differs. The guard refuses correctly; its sentence is narrower than its rule.
title: Pin the hyperschema algebra version at rest — nothing observed accounts.ts's `alg`
